title: Product Search Functionality
description: Users should be able to search for products by name, category, or keyword.
acceptance_criteria: User can enter a search term and view matching products
Search results display product name, price, and thumbnail image
System returns results within 2 seconds of submitting search

title: Shopping Cart Management
description: Users should be able to add, remove, and update items in their shopping cart.
acceptance_criteria: User can add a product to the cart from the product detail page
Cart displays correct total price including quantity adjustments
User receives confirmation message when item is added to cart

title: Checkout Payment Processing
description: Users should be able to complete purchase using multiple payment methods.
acceptance_criteria: User can select from credit card, debit card, or digital wallet payment
System validates payment details before processing transaction
Order confirmation page displays order number and estimated delivery date
